Home / About Fence Wizards

Fence Wizards

Three Generations of Fencing

Fence Wizards is a family business based in Greenwood, Indiana. Richard Warren runs the company with his father and brother, serving contractors, event organizers, and businesses across central Indiana.

Request a quoteCall Richard(317) 296-4015

Experience on the crew

Richard is a third-generation fencer. More than ten years of permanent fencing experience informs the temporary installations the family handles today.

The business invests in current installation equipment to help the crew work efficiently. The trucks and fencing belong to Fence Wizards, and material is purchased directly from manufacturers.

A working relationship with the owner

Richard handles quotes and service calls. He stays involved when a layout changes, a gate needs moving, or the fence is ready for pickup.

The aim is to be a dependable contact for the next project as well as this one. Flat-fee quotes, included removal, and same-day service for general contractors are part of that approach.

Insurance and project requirements

We carry umbrella, general liability, commercial auto, and workers compensation insurance. Ask Richard for the certificates your project requires.

Fence Wizards was named in Where To Get Stuff Fixed in 2023.

Sites where our fencing has been used

Our fencing has been on sites including the NBA All Star Game Google Pixel Event, the Final Four, Ball State University, Veterans Affairs, the Social Security Administration, and White River State Park.

These names identify project locations and end users. They do not imply that each venue or institution hired Fence Wizards directly.

Focused on temporary fencing

We supply temporary fence rentals, windscreen, and crowd-control barricades. We do not offer permanent fence installation, residential fencing, repairs, gate automation, stanchions, orange fencing, or fence material sales.
